# Prospective component confirmation transport

This fixture packages the original confirmation job after the unchanged component method was selected in [the method selection receipt](../../../docs/qwen-components-method-selection-v1.json). The [confirmation freeze](../../../docs/qwen-components-confirmation-freeze-v1.json) was recorded before confirmation preparation. No confirmation ranking, GPU invocation or quality result exists at this deployment stage; confirmation must pass the original gates before the protocol-defined human pilot.

The **79,268-byte** [kaggle-upload.zip](kaggle-upload.zip), SHA-256 `4a2f1c9e4bcf4c8d620516233ffad857a052cdc4f3465920513c36ed6ce33096`, is an exact copy of the general preparer's output. Its five regular, flat members are the original `job.json`, three original executables and the accepted separately pinned bootstrap. The trusted job payload SHA-256 is `46cdb4be34507d170d656eeba19478bf493acdfe6315a352ae37bc941d0b19e5`.

[preparation.json](preparation.json) and [bootstrap-preparation.json](bootstrap-preparation.json) preserve both original receipts byte for byte. [generated-notebook.ipynb](generated-notebook.ipynb) preserves the generated notebook. [configured-notebook.ipynb](configured-notebook.ipynb) changes only its `BUNDLE` placeholder to an exact selector for the nested and legacy mounts of the private dataset `qwen-components-confirmation-bootstrap-v1`; missing or ambiguous mounts stop. [submission.py](submission.py) concatenates those three configured code cells. Every original executable and the additional bootstrap's size/hash are checked before helper import. Outputs and installer, CUDA audit, model and scoring settings remain those of the generated notebook.

[deployment.json](deployment.json) records all transport pins, the original job/executable/profile bindings, both freezes, selection, accepted bootstrap, general preparer, installer wheel and zero calls performed by packaging. It preserves software baseline `85b5df4`. The bootstrap uses an isolated pip-free installer environment and the exact official pip 25.2 wheel; it leaves the original worker and its audit unchanged. The package contains public article passages and reviewer requests, with no answers, ledger, credentials, model weights or environment cache.

The passages derive from two CC BY 4.0 main articles: Alfuraih et al., [thyroid TI-RADS agreement](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0312121), and Schilling et al. and the COPCOV Collaborative Group, [COVID-19 prophylaxis trial](https://journals.plos.org/plosmedicine/article?id=10.1371/journal.pmed.1004428). Canonical passages normalize whitespace and table text. Full attribution, copyright, license notices and original source provenance remain in the [confirmation source archive](../qwen_components_confirmation_sources/README.md); no linked supplements or underlying patient data are included.

Packaging checks only compile the script, compare original bytes and code-cell equivalence, verify the frozen file hashes, and exercise the two-mount selector with simulated paths. Independent evaluation and publication precede any saved GPU run. No installer, network request or model call was executed during packaging.
